speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Actinic Keratosis

The description of a rough, sandpaper-like plaque on the dorsal hand in a fair-skinned patient with significant sun exposure is classic for Actinic Keratosis. Your denial of pain or tenderness supports a benign etiology rather than an infection or malignancy like squamous cell carcinoma. Given the location and morphology, I am confident this is not a urinary tract infection.
